name: Seeking Refuge

angles.text: As a priest, you may find Bandarion Keep's way compelling. Its members pursue meditation and guidance in the Holy Light despite prejudice against undead wielders.
As a paladin, you can see the divide between the hateful zealots at Crusader's Outpost and Bareth Dawnstone's pursuit of benevolence and protection through the Light.
As Forsaken, you may face hostility from living zealots and skeptical kin if you revere the Holy Light. The growing brotherhood at Bandarion Keep offers a rare sanctuary.
As Horde, you help keep couriers moving between Bandarion Keep and Brill. Emerging neutral or allied orders gain a foothold in Tirisfal Glades against hostile crusaders.

faq.answer: Bareth Dawnstone is a devotee of the Holy Light at Bandarion Keep. He was on his way to Brill with a message when zealots ambushed and imprisoned him because he is undead. He meditates on the Light and seeks to use it for protection.

Zealots at Crusader's Outpost ambushed Bareth Dawnstone on the road from Bandarion Keep. He laments that they wield the Holy Light with hatred, twisting the benevolence he meditates upon as they persecute those they judge to be abominations.
faq.q: Who captured Bareth Dawnstone, and why?

faq.answer: Shari Stilwell represents the monastery's order in the Forsaken town of Brill. She receives travelers and coordinates with emissaries from Bandarion Keep. She welcomes anyone seeking guidance in the Light.

Bandarion Keep is a secluded monastery on the bluffs northwest of Solliden Farmstead in Tirisfal Glades. It is a sanctuary and training ground for a growing religious order devoted to meditation and study of the Holy Light.

aliases: why do they hate his kind
bareth what is left of my blood
faq.answer: Bareth Dawnstone speaks of what remains of his blood and acknowledges prejudice against his kind. He is an undead practitioner of the Holy Light. Tirisfal's fanatical crusaders despise all undead and refuse to believe their intentions or devotion can be pure.
faq.q: Why do Bareth's captors take issue with his kind?

aliases: what is the order at bandarion keep
faq.answer: Bandarion Keep is home to a young monastic brotherhood taking root on the bluffs of Tirisfal. The order teaches peaceful meditation and protection. It welcomes anyone seeking true guidance in the Light.
faq.q: What kind of order is based at Bandarion Keep?

sections.body: Bareth Dawnstone left Bandarion Keep to speak with Shari Stilwell in Brill. Zealous warriors seized him at Crusader's Outpost before he could reach her. They despise him for being undead, yet Bareth remains devoted to the Light. He seeks a way out of their hands and a chance to deliver his message.
sections.title: A Perilous Journey

sections.body: At Crusader's Outpost, zealots wield the Holy Light with rigid conviction and vengeance. They see Bareth's existence as an offense. He meditates on the Light as a source of protection and inner purity. His captors' cruelty grieves him, for it twists the sacred teachings he cherishes.
sections.title: Vengeance Versus Devotion

sections.body: In Brill, Shari Stilwell learns that Bareth has escaped and is safe. Their monastic order is still taking root on the bluffs northwest of Solliden Farmstead. Losing a promising practitioner like Bareth would have hurt the young fellowship. Its doors are open to travelers seeking sincere guidance in the Light.
sections.title: Sanctuary on the Bluffs

summary: At Crusader's Outpost, Bareth Dawnstone waits far from the meeting in Brill he was sent to reach. His safe return matters to the young order at Bandarion Keep, where followers of the Holy Light face prejudice from local zealots.
